name: exp5_optimizers_knees
_note: Optimizer comparison on the 520-weight kneed brain (23->16->8). Every variant gets the same episode budget, the same shared train scenarios per generation, and the same champion rule (recommend() re-scored on validation terrains). es_raw is the literal whiteboard update (raw fitness weights, plain SGD, no baseline/ranks/Adam); alpha=2e-5 is sized so the first update is ~0.01 per weight at reward ~500. This experiment holds the fall rule at penalty so all optimizers see the same knees-v2 landscape.

hypotheses.text: At an equal episode budget, OpenAI-ES (antithetic pairs, centered ranks, Adam) reaches a higher held-out test distance IQM than the literal raw-fitness update theta += alpha/(n*sigma) * sum(F_i * eps_i). A non-significant result is inconclusive.
